content_md:
Assuming we get to near-fully populated changelogs, what’s the best way to show updates to evolving big pieces like [[5vt4cvsxvs6h2m5yqzk2hn4d4v | Matt Sweet’s protocol thinking piece?]]. It keeps popping up in my feed but shows the same way.

Simplest solution, which I’ll implement soon, is to show the latest changelog first. But there’s probably interesting rollup-narration too. I’m thinking a system prompt in settings that says something like “use haiku to summarize changelogs and point to changed sections” etc. Or more complex prompts that make ignore/flag decisions.
